meta.subject: History
meta.source: Government of Tamil Nadu Higher Secondary First Year History, Revised Edition 2025, English and Tamil editions supplied by the user
meta.question_style: Maximum useful source-grounded bilingual competitive-exam coverage from Unit 10: Arab conquest of Sind; Ghaznavids and Mahmud; Muhammad Ghori and Tarain; Rajput kingdoms and military comparison; Slave/Mamluk dynasty, Iltutmish, Raziya and Balban; Khalji conquests, Chahalgani, Alauddin's administrative and market reforms; Tughlaq experiments, Firuz Tughlaq, Timur; Sayyids and Lodis; Sultanate state, iqta, revenue and society; economy, trade and technology; education, historiography, Sufism, Caliphate, women and slavery; Indo-Islamic architecture, music, literature and Sanskrit interaction.
meta.quality_policy: Four-option bilingual MCQs grounded only in the supplied 2025 textbook. Activities, reference-list material and unsupported outside corrections are excluded. Where the English and Tamil editions use different framing or spellings, questions retain source context and standard textbook terminology rather than silently harmonizing with outside knowledge.
meta.page_reference_note: page_en refers to the printed English textbook page; Tamil printed page numbers differ and are not inferred.

questions.q_en:
Consider the following statements:
I. Historiographical condition regarding the true nature of the Delhi Sultanate — Achievements and failures of individual Sultans.
II. Conventional way of evaluating Sultanate regimes — Achievements and failures of individual Sultans.
Which option is correct?
questions.q_ta:
பின்வரும் கூற்றுகளைக் கவனிக்கவும்:
I. தில்லி சுல்தானியத்தின் உண்மையான தன்மை குறித்து வரலாற்றாசிரியர்களின் நிலை — தனித்த சுல்தான்களின் சாதனைகள் மற்றும் தோல்விகள்.
II. சுல்தானிய ஆட்சியை வழக்கமாக மதிப்பிடும் முறை — தனித்த சுல்தான்களின் சாதனைகள் மற்றும் தோல்விகள்.
சரியான விடை எது?
opts_en: Both I and II are correct
I is correct; II is incorrect
I is incorrect; II is correct
Both I and II are incorrect
questions.exp_en: Statement I is incorrect and Statement II is correct.
questions.exp_ta: கூற்று I தவறு; கூற்று II சரி.
